name: Aloy
description: The protagonist of Horizon Zero Dawn, Aloy is an outlander who crossed into Teyvat as part of a collaboration between HoYoverse and Guerrilla Games. A skilled hunter raised by the Nora tribe, she wields a bow infused with Cryo energy and continues her adventures as a wandering heroine.
city: Outlander (Horizon Zero Dawn crossover, not native to Teyvat)
